name: Hayabusa Return Capsule
about: Hayabusa Return Capsule (2003-019, ISASJ), launched 2003 May  9. Its phases from GCAT: Earth, HCO, Itokawa, Woomera. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.
